text:
Kai: Day zero checklist question  badge pickup, laptop handoff, VPN, GH perms, calendar invites, and how to set quiet hours for onboarding bots? Don't want noise.
IT Desk: Badge -> #people-ops with full name + office. Laptop handoff -> ping IT Desk with serial & preferred OS image. VPN -> #help with 'vpn' in the first line + region. GH perms -> Access form (link pinned in #devex) then ping DevEx if it stalls. Calendar/corp invites -> People Ops auto-sends within 24h; DM if missing.
People Ops: If you need badge mailed, DM shipping address. For intro calendar blocks we add a 30m "onboarding sync" during week 1 unless you opt out. To opt out say "skip calendar" in DM.
Kai: Nice. Quiet hours? The onboarding bot DMed me at midnight.
OnboardBot: Commands: `/onboard prefs` opens DM toggles, `/onboard pause 7d` pauses DMs for 7 days, `/onboard nightmode 22:00-07:00` mutes messages during that window. Use `/onboard stop` to unsubscribe.
Kai: Where do I post follow-ups if infra needs to act?
Infra Bot: Post infra/cloud requests in #eng-infra with project id and short justification. For team-only items start in your squad channel and thread it. If filing an Access Form include the ticket link in your thread so infra can pick it up.
Marta: Etiquette: use threads, react with :eyes: for ack, avoid @channel unless office-wide. For urgent stuff tag the person and add URGENT in the first line. For long logs use a Gist link and one-line summary.
Kai: Thanks everyone  that clears things up :wave:
